description: jevmem: queue each finished turn for Jev (Stop, async), add the relevant project memories to each prompt (UserPromptSubmit), put the project's always-on rules in front of Claude at the start of every session and, once per machine while the setup is unfinished, say what is left (SessionStart), and check Bash, Edit and Write calls against the project's saved rules before they run (PreToolUse). Runs the separate jevmem command-line tool; does nothing in a project until `jevmem enable`.
